summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Young Scientist Academy MVP. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass (blog list, blog by valid slug, seeded slug, invalid slug 404, enquiry create for demo/contact/assessment, invalid kind rejection, missing field validation, list sorted). Frontend: homepage hero renders headline (split across styled spans), Book a Free Demo opens enquiry dialog and submits successfully closing dialog, Board Assessment CTA opens dialog, Contact form submits without error, Floating WhatsApp + Call buttons appear after scroll, Blog nav lists cards and opens post page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses asyncio.create_task for email — good non-blocking pattern, but if the app is under load, unhandled task exceptions are only logged; consider FastAPI BackgroundTasks for lifecycle safety.
Enquiry slug for test in problem statement mentions 'curious-minds-53' which is actually the preview host; correct seeded slug is 'concept-based-learning-vs-rote'. Not a bug, just doc mismatch.
OWNER_EMAIL is a placeholder (info@ysaindore.com); ensure real inbox is configured before launch.
No rate limiting or captcha on /api/enquiries — spam risk in production.
seed_data_creation: 4 blog posts seeded on backend startup; 3 TEST_ prefixed enquiries created during tests (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://curious-minds-53.preview.emergentagent.com/api. All endpoints healthy. Frontend data-testids in place. Hero H1 text is split across styled spans, so use partial text like 'Curious Minds' or 'Innovators' rather than full 'Building Curious Minds. Creating Future Innovators.' when asserting via text=.
